subject: Verification request: service interruption on Dec 17 — credit eligibility and post-incident plan
messages:
From: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@acme-retail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 18:12:05 -0500
Subject: Service interruption Dec 17 (13:05–13:50 ET) — request for confirmation and credit

Marcus —

We observed a substantial interruption in API availability this afternoon that impacted search suggestions in our storefront. Scope: roughly 13:05–13:50 ET (we're in NYC). Symptoms were repeated 503/Service Unavailable on generation and a big spike in tail latency for embeddings requests. Our telemetry shows ~45 minutes where error rates were >70% for the region-bound route serving the storefront.

Can you confirm whether this maps to a Redwood outage window and advise on whether this meets SLA credit eligibility? We need the official window and an initial estimate of credit given our committed Dedicated capacity (contract ACME-2025-ENTERPRISE-03).

I've attached a short CSV with a sample of errors and timestamps. Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Sofia Torres
Head of Platform Ops
Acme Retail
sofia.torres@acme-retail.com

Attachment: acme_error_samples_20261217.csv (3KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 18:28:42 -0500
Subject: Re: Service interruption Dec 17 (13:05–13:50 ET) — request for confirmation and credit

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the heads up and for the sample file — I've pulled your CSV. Sorry for the disruption. I'm opening an internal investigation and can confirm we'll treat this as an SLA eligibility request under your Dedicated contract. To proceed we need to verify the precise impacted window from our side (ingestion, routing, and node availability), and correlate to your incoming request IDs.

Immediate next steps from Redwood (we'll action these by EOD tomorrow):
- Monica will pull the serving logs and node health traces for the us-east cluster during the period you reported.
- Lauren will compute availability per SLA definition and prepare an initial credit estimate for the ACME account.
- I'll coordinate to get you a log bundle and a short summary (window, root-candidate, credit calc).

Can you confirm whether the attached samples are representative (same route: /v1/generation/stream) and whether you have any request IDs you want us to prioritize? Also confirm billing contact and whether you prefer a formal post-incident call or a written summary first.

I'll follow up with the log bundle and preliminary window by tomorrow morning.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, billing@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Service interruption Dec 17 — confirmed window, credit estimate, and post-incident plan

Sofia / Acme ops team —

Thanks for the patience. Summary of findings from our initial review (attached log bundle and SLA figures):

- Confirmed customer impact window (per Redwood edge and serving traces): 2026-12-17T13:07:12Z through 2026-12-17T13:48:29Z (UTC). This maps to ~13:07–13:48 ET in your telemetry.
- Root-candidate: transient routing controller overload in us-east that caused request queuing and several worker restarts under a burst of short-lived background jobs. This led to a high rate of 503s and elevated tail latency for the /v1/generation/stream route.
- SLA classification: The incident reduces availability below the 99.9% monthly target for the affected route and dedicated capacity. Per the Dedicated contract (ACME-2025-ENTERPRISE-03) we consider this eligible for a pro-rata credit for the impacted minutes.

Initial credit estimate (preliminary): based on the confirmed outage window above and your committed monthly reserved capacity, Lauren ran the SLA calc and the initial credit is estimated at 6.5% of the monthly service fee for December. We'll provide a formal accounting statement once you confirm the billing contact.

Attachments included:
- redwood-log-bundle-20261217.tar.gz (server traces, routing logs, kv-cache metrics)
- slo-availability-figures-20261217.pdf (worked example of calculation methodology)

Next steps (recommended):
1) Please confirm billing@acme-retail.com as the invoice contact for the credit. Once confirmed we'll draft a formal credit memo and timeline for application (typically next billing cycle).
2) We can schedule a 20-minute post-incident call to walk through the root-candidate and remediation plan. Proposed windows: today 16:00–17:00 ET or tomorrow 10:00–11:00 ET — let me know what works.
3) Internal actions: Monica will open an RCA ticket (INF-2041) and we'll share a written post-incident report within 3 business days with remediation items and mitigations to prevent routing overloads (rate-limiter updates, faster worker recycling, and tighter autoscaling thresholds).

If you want an immediate technical deep-dive prior to the report, let me know and I'll loop in runtime engineering. Otherwise we'll proceed with the written report and a short call at your convenience.

Apologies again for the disruption — we'll make sure the remediation items are tracked and prioritized.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
